technical.summary: Bullish technicals with strong moving average alignment and rising RSI across all timeframes, but weak trend strength (ADX 11.89), overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), and low volume conviction limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: MTB shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 26 days.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with only small sales from junior members; market fear (42 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity but lack of news data and neutral AAII sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (403.2), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, with earnings event in 26 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with rising RSI across all timeframes and bullish supertrend/hull confirmation provides technical structure for swing entry in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 11.89), overbought conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), low volume conviction (0.64 ratio), zero fundamental support, macro crisis (VIX 403.2, flat yield curve, rising dollar), and earnings risk in 26 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.
